about.title: The longer version.
about.p1: I found my way to frontend through games, long before university made it official. Somewhere between figuring out game menus and sitting through lectures, I got hooked on how interfaces work.
about.p2: Now I build ones that are useful, intuitive and easy for anyone to pick up, ideally on products that make things a little better for everyone. Mostly frontend, with enough backend to take a feature from the API all the way to the button.
about.p3: At work I do my best in a team where ideas get shared and people actually talk to each other, on projects people rely on, from healthcare to the apps they open every day.
about.p4: Off the clock I read about new tech, keep an eye on where AI is heading, train, play games and watch a lot of films. Choosing one usually takes longer than watching it.

codeus.summary: Software agency from Podgorica building scalable web and mobile apps for startups and companies.

projects.name: US healthcare platform
projects.description: A platform for the US healthcare system where doctors and patients pull in and manage their data from their own hospitals. Doctors can also query the patients enrolled in their research projects and pull statistics from the results.

features.name: Three sub-portals
features.description: Separate portals for doctors, patients and researchers, each shaped around how they actually work. Built with Vue, Vuetify, Pinia and TypeScript.

features.name: HIPAA-compliant AI chat
features.description: An AI assistant built right into the platform, used by both doctors and patients. It meets HIPAA requirements, so health data stays protected the whole way through.

projects.name: Codeus corporate website
projects.description: The company's own website. Bilingual, with light and dark themes, and built to be found: SEO and GEO are tracked so it shows up in search results as well as in AI-generated answers.

features.name: SEO & GEO
features.description: Structured data, a sitemap, hreflang for both languages and generated social preview images, so the site reads well to search engines and AI answer engines alike.

features.name: UI/UX
features.description: Interface built with Nuxt UI, with optimised images, smooth light and dark modes and layouts that hold up from phone to widescreen.

projects.name: Marketing agency platform
projects.description:
An internal platform for a marketing agency, built to run their day-to-day work in one place: planning and tracking campaigns, managing ads across channels and keeping on top of their clients and users.

It was an inherited legacy codebase on Vue 2, Vuex and plain JavaScript, and despite the older architecture it ran and was maintained as smoothly as anything built on a modern stack.

amplitudo.summary: A hands-on academy where I went from the basics to shipping a full project.

projects.name: Fundamentals
projects.description: Built a solid base in how the web works, from markup and styling to scripting and server-side code.

projects.name: Academy project
projects.description: A full project built from scratch, with a React frontend talking to a Laravel API.

ucg.summary: Three years of Computer Science, a lot of late-night coding and a degree finished on time.

projects.name: Core curriculum
projects.description: Algorithms and data structures, object-oriented programming, databases, computer networks, operating systems and software engineering. The groundwork every interface I build still sits on.

projects.name: Where it clicked
projects.description: The web development courses were where it all came together for me. Seeing code turn into something people could actually click and use is what pointed me towards frontend.
